author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Final live acceptance, 2026-09-25 23:48–23:51Z. One sequential, read-only session on the deployed 1a9baed build. The served voice.js matched the landed hash. The front-door sign-in hop was bypassed: the page and websocket went through the local ingress, with the websocket path and read-scope credential unchanged. The front-door hop is covered by the owner's signed-in phone test. #15 transcript-dedup: PASS. After two spoken turns the log held 5 rows in order assistant, user, assistant, user, assistant: 2 user rows and 3 assistant rows, which is one finalized row per utterance per side. The same sentence spoken twice was kept as 2 separate rows with identical text. 0 rows repeated text. 12 user partials and 2 assistant partials were folded into their final rows. Closing.
